guidance.heading: OUTLOOK
section: Assuming no significant positive or negative change in the operating environment, the Company expects fourth quarter 2026 adjusted diluted EPS to be in the range of $1.30 to $1.40. The Company expects full-year net capital expenditures excluding real estate; to be in the range of between $225 million and $250 million. The Company expects year-over-year adjusted operating ratio, a non-IFRS measure, improvement in the quarter of 400 to 500 basis points for the Truckload segment, 100 to 200 basis points for the Logistics segment, and to have a 0 to 100 basis points decline in the Less-Than-Truckload segment.
